**Skill this week:** access analysis. By the end of the week you should be able to define food security and food deserts, measure access with buffers and travel-time areas, and explain how infectious and diet-related diseases now overlap in the same populations.

## Public health case

Vukuzazi screened 17,118 people in rural KwaZulu-Natal. More than half had at least one active disease. HIV was well controlled (78.1%), but high blood pressure (42.5%) and high blood glucose (7.1%) mostly were not.
